opening.argument: The video is presented as an operational cryptocurrency tutorial, identifying how to transfer Litecoin or Bitcoin from Coinbase to Binance and emphasizing the need to send funds to the correct location. The demonstration proceeds through the transfer process, including entering a PIN and sending Litecoin, while the Binance interface visibly shows an LTC deposit address, QR-code control, and instructions to send only LTC to that address. The presentation also includes affiliate-style promotion: it describes a conditional $10 Bitcoin reward tied to a $100 deposit and says a link will be provided. Those promotional elements do not establish deceptive solicitation or a falsely guaranteed financial outcome; the observable role remains instructional, with limited referral promotion.
